tags.label: Testing
tags.description: Create or run tests, regression reproducers or agent evaluations.
tags.guidance: Include workflows that explicitly author or execute tests; exclude incidental validation commands. Choose one primary Task; add up to two secondary Tasks only for explicit additional workflows.

tags.label: Debugging
tags.description: Investigate failures through logs, dumps, reproductions and root-cause analysis.
tags.guidance: Include diagnosis and bug investigation; use Testing for workflows whose output is a test case. Choose one primary Task; add up to two secondary Tasks only for explicit additional workflows.

tags.label: Build & CI
tags.description: Configure builds, packaging, build-tool upgrades or continuous integration.
tags.guidance: Include build configuration and CI operation; running a build to check an unrelated edit is insufficient. Choose one primary Task; add up to two secondary Tasks only for explicit additional workflows.

tags.label: Version control & release
tags.description: Prepare commits, cherry-picks or release coordination.
tags.guidance: Include version-control and backport workflows; do not assign for a routine git command in another task. Choose one primary Task; add up to two secondary Tasks only for explicit additional workflows.

tags.label: Documentation & knowledge
tags.description: Write documentation or maintain reusable workflow knowledge.
tags.guidance: Include code examples, knowledge stores and skill maintenance; reading documentation alone is insufficient. Choose one primary Task; add up to two secondary Tasks only for explicit additional workflows.

tags.label: Code quality
tags.description: Improve style, inspections, structural consistency or API hygiene.
tags.guidance: Include lint authoring and visibility cleanups; use Debugging for investigating an observed failure. Choose one primary Task; add up to two secondary Tasks only for explicit additional workflows.

tags.label: Language design
tags.description: Define language concepts, semantics, constraints and composition.
tags.guidance: Include language aspects and node-factory definitions; editing model instances belongs to Model & AST work. Choose one primary Task; add up to two secondary Tasks only for explicit additional workflows.

tags.label: Code generation
tags.description: Define transformations or templates that generate code or text.
tags.guidance: Include generators, generation plans and text generation; handwritten code changes alone do not qualify. Choose one primary Task; add up to two secondary Tasks only for explicit additional workflows.

tags.label: Model & AST work
tags.description: Construct, query, modify or migrate concrete models and AST nodes.
tags.guidance: Include model operations and quotations; designing language semantics alone belongs to Language design. Choose one primary Task; add up to two secondary Tasks only for explicit additional workflows.

tags.label: Editor & UI
tags.description: Build or adjust editors, interactive behaviour and desktop interfaces.
tags.guidance: Include intentions, keymaps, editor layouts and UI interop; host plugin registration alone is IDE integration. Choose one primary Task; add up to two secondary Tasks only for explicit additional workflows.

tags.label: IDE integration
tags.description: Integrate actions, plugins or extensions with an IDE host.
tags.guidance: Include extension points and IDE-specific development; UI rendering alone belongs to Editor & UI. Choose one primary Task; add up to two secondary Tasks only for explicit additional workflows.

tags.label: Project setup & dependencies
tags.description: Organise projects, modules, dependencies, source sets or run configurations.
tags.guidance: Include project structure and dependency setup; build-tool version upgrades belong to Build & CI. Choose one primary Task; add up to two secondary Tasks only for explicit additional workflows.

tags.label: Performance analysis
tags.description: Measure workflow cost or runtime performance and study optimisations.
tags.guidance: Include profiling and comparative optimisation experiments; an unmeasured performance mention is insufficient. Choose one primary Task; add up to two secondary Tasks only for explicit additional workflows.

tags.label: Calculations
tags.description: Evaluate numeric expressions and return calculated results.
tags.guidance: Include arithmetic-evaluation workflows, including fixture skills; test-fixture storage alone does not mean Testing. Choose one primary Task; add up to two secondary Tasks only for explicit additional workflows.

tags.label: Weather
tags.description: Retrieve weather conditions or forecasts for a location.
tags.guidance: Include weather-information workflows, including fixture skills; do not classify by the repository storing them. Choose one primary Task; add up to two secondary Tasks only for explicit additional workflows.

tags.label: Unit tests
tags.description: Tests of individual components, methods or model-level behaviour.
tags.guidance: Include workflows that author or run component tests; exclude fixture storage and incidental test mentions.

tags.label: Integration tests
tags.description: Tests of combined systems or supported tool/version combinations.
tags.guidance: Include integration test matrices and cross-component tests; isolated unit tests use Unit tests.

tags.label: Agent evaluations
tags.description: Evaluation scenarios and measurements for agent behaviour.
tags.guidance: Include agent verification or skill-optimisation studies; ordinary software tests alone do not qualify.

tags.label: Compiler diagnostics
tags.description: Language-analysis errors, warnings and diagnostic regression cases.
tags.guidance: Include compiler/type-system diagnostic tests; IDE lint inspections alone use Code quality.

tags.label: Type system
tags.description: Type inference, type checking and type-system rules.
tags.guidance: Include workflows operating on typing rules; mentioning types while editing unrelated code is insufficient.

tags.label: Constraints & scopes
tags.description: Structural restrictions, reference scopes and name-resolution constraints.
tags.guidance: Include constraint and scope definitions; general project dependencies use Dependencies.

tags.label: Dataflow
tags.description: Control/dataflow analysis and its language-analysis rules.
tags.guidance: Include analysis instructions and dataflow operations; arbitrary data processing is insufficient.

tags.label: Generators
tags.description: Generator templates, transformations and generation plans.
tags.guidance: Include workflows that configure or edit generation; consuming generated output alone is insufficient.

tags.label: Models & AST
tags.description: Structured models, nodes, ASTs and their operations or language structure.
tags.guidance: Include concrete node operations or language structure; ordinary source text alone is insufficient.

tags.label: Language composition
tags.description: Language extension, inheritance and modular composition.
tags.guidance: Include combining languages or aspects; ordinary application-module setup uses Dependencies.

tags.label: Migrations
tags.description: Versioned model changes and migration scripts.
tags.guidance: Include migration authoring or execution; a build-tool version bump alone does not qualify.

tags.label: Editor behaviour
tags.description: Editor interactions, intentions, keymaps and node-editing behaviour.
tags.guidance: Include editor workflows and copy/paste handlers; general desktop styling uses Desktop UI.

tags.label: Desktop UI
tags.description: Desktop widget rendering, layouts and toolkit interoperability.
tags.guidance: Include Compose/Jewel/Swing UI workflows; model editor semantics use Editor behaviour.

tags.label: IDE plugins
tags.description: IDE actions, extension points and plugin infrastructure.
tags.guidance: Include host integration workflows; merely working in an IDE is insufficient.

tags.label: Gradle
tags.description: Gradle wrappers, APIs, source sets and test/build configuration.
tags.guidance: Include direct Gradle configuration or version work; one incidental Gradle command is insufficient.

tags.label: CI
tags.description: Automated build pipelines, agents and CI operational tooling.
tags.guidance: Include pipeline work or explicit CI diagnosis; routine local build commands do not qualify.

tags.label: Dependencies
tags.description: Project/module dependency relationships and source-set organisation.
tags.guidance: Include dependency authoring, resolution or restructuring; companion-skill references are not dependencies.

tags.label: API design
tags.description: Public/internal API boundaries, visibility and stability.
tags.guidance: Include API-hygiene decisions; calling an API in an unrelated workflow is insufficient.

tags.label: Documentation
tags.description: Explanatory documentation, examples and reusable knowledge records.
tags.guidance: Include documentation-writing workflows; reading documentation for another task is insufficient.

tags.label: Release tracking
tags.description: Backport issues and coordination of release changes.
tags.guidance: Include tracking release/backport delivery; a routine commit alone uses Version control & release.

tags.label: Performance
tags.description: Runtime efficiency, resource use, profiling and measured workflow cost.
tags.guidance: Include performance diagnosis or measurement; generic optimisation claims alone are insufficient.

tags.label: MPS
tags.description: JetBrains MPS languages, models, editors and project tooling.
tags.guidance: Include workflows that require MPS; platform-neutral skills stored in MPS do not qualify.

tags.label: IntelliJ Platform
tags.description: IntelliJ Platform APIs, plugins and IDE infrastructure.
tags.guidance: Include host-platform workflows, also in Android Studio; repository location alone is insufficient.

tags.label: Android Studio
tags.description: Android Studio-specific development, diagnosis and evaluation.
tags.guidance: Include workflows tied to Android Studio; general Jewel/Swing work is not automatically Studio-specific.

tags.label: Kotlin
tags.description: Kotlin code, compiler, analysis APIs and ecosystem tooling.
tags.guidance: Include Kotlin-specific workflows; storage in the Kotlin repository alone is insufficient.

tags.label: Kotlin Multiplatform
tags.description: Kotlin shared and platform-specific source-set organisation.
tags.guidance: Include KMP/JVM/non-JVM restructuring; Kotlin-only work without multiplatform scope is insufficient.

tags.label: Compose / Jewel
tags.description: Compose Desktop and Jewel UI components or Swing interop.
tags.guidance: Include workflows that use these toolkits; generic IDE integration alone does not qualify.

tags.label: TeamCity
tags.description: TeamCity build and CI management or investigation tooling.
tags.guidance: Include TeamCity-specific operations; generic CI work without TeamCity scope is insufficient.
